faq.q: How many styles are there and will they work in my Instagram bio?
faq.a: There are roughly 30 styles including Bold Serif, Italic, Script, Fraktur, Double-Struck, Monospace, Circled, Squared, Fullwidth, Small Caps, Superscript, Upside Down, Mirrored and wrapped styles like Stars and Hearts. They're Unicode characters, not real fonts, so they work in most bios, WhatsApp, Twitter/X and Discord — but may render as empty boxes on devices lacking the glyphs, and can break screen readers and search.

faq.q: Why isn't my styled name searchable, and should I use it for my business name?
faq.a: Because the styled letters are different Unicode code points from ordinary letters, searching for your real name won't match them. The tool itself warns against this: avoid styled text for names, business names or contact details. A single decorative line in a bio is fine; a whole name people need to find is not.

faq.q: What does the Instagram Bio Builder's character counter actually count?
faq.a: It counts code points (using the spread operator over the string), showing 'X / 150 characters' and turning the counter pink with an 'over the limit!' warning past 150. Note that styled Unicode characters can count differently on Instagram than plain letters, so the counter is a guide — watch it when mixing styled text into a bio.

faq.q: Does the tool remember my favourites, and does it work on text other than letters?
faq.a: Favourites are stored in your browser under the ffFavs key and pinned to the top; copy counts are stored under ffCounts and shown as 'used N×'. Styled letters only exist for A–Z, a–z and digits, so punctuation, emoji and other scripts pass through unchanged — the tool warns you if your text contains no Latin letters or digits.
